correctness.rationale: For each h in (0,2) the kick-then-drift M(h) is elliptic, determinant-one and preserves G_h=[[1,-h/2],[-h/2,1]]. Positive covariance and adjoint eigenmatrices exist and have full rank since an elliptic M(h) has no invariant real line. Jensen strict log-det equality forces a common invariant G_h if rho=1, which is possible only for a point-mass law; an adjoint Perron quadratic form gives uniform two-sided expected-energy rho^n bounds. The exact three-moment-coordinate transfer and analytic symmetric jitter coefficient follow from differentiation of the simple eigenvalue. Independently expanded the exact symbolic determinant det(I-T_{h,e})=-2e^2(h-e)^2(h+e)^2. The proof addresses arbitrary iid laws supported in (0,2); finite symbolic testing alone would not.
